resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a standard biometric update because the candidate set contained whitelisted records whose face did not match the applicant, even though the applicant was whitelisted.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a biometric update while carrying a whitelist that should have allowed the matched records to be processed together. The whitelist grouping instead included records whose face does not belong to this resident, so the exemption could not be applied and the packet was rejected. The whitelist grouping has to be reviewed and corrected by an operator before the packet can move on.
